title: Chapter 735 The Sun Sets (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 735 The Sun Sets (Part 2)

"After I came to the border of Nanjun, there were rumors everywhere that General Wei had died in the battle in Lingnan, and he was named Wuzhonghou by the First Emperor. I thought the pavilion chief was really gone..."

Ji Ying is a person who attaches great importance to old relationships. After going through all kinds of hardships, when he finally saw Hei Fu, he burst into tears, wiped his hands full of snot, and pinched Hei Fu's face to see if he was real... …

"Stop it."

With an old friend like Ji Ying, Hei Fu was not polite and kicked him away.

Ji Ying rolled in the mud, covered his butt and laughed: "This strength is really like the blow I received when I was hiding in the house to scare the pavilion commander when I was serving in Anlu County. It seems that the pavilion commander He is really alive!"

He then frowned worriedly: "But why did you lie to outsiders and say you were dead? Now the entire Nan County believes it is true."

Hei Fu skipped the question: "You will know about all the changes in the south later. Where are my wife and son?"

At the beginning of the thirty-seventh year, Heifu calculated that time was almost up and sent Ji Ying and Sang Mu to deliver a message to the young master Fusu on his behalf to prevent him from being brutally murdered like in history.

Unexpectedly, Xianyang suddenly changed dramatically, and Fusu ran away. Heifu's family also saw the opportunity and ran away together.

Although Fusu's family members were caught shortly after running away, there was still no news about Hei's wife and son. Seeing that his mother and brother in Anlu County had fallen into the hands of the court, and now there was no news about his wife, Hei's husband was worried. .

Now Ji Ying finally got through Hei Fu's personal connections in Nan County. After several stops and traveling across mountains and rivers, he came to the hiding place of their group in Yunmengze. However, he did not see his wife or son. Hei Fu couldn't help but feel a thump in his heart. …

If his wife and son really died, wouldn't he be scolded again for being an abuser?

Fortunately, Ji Ying immediately said: "Pavilion Chief, please rest assured that my wife and the two gentlemen are all very well!"

Following Ji Ying's narration, Heifu finally knew the whereabouts of his family after the drastic changes in Xianyang a few months ago.

"When I left Xianyang, my wife told me that after leaving the city, I should not go with Master Fusu on the same road, but stay away from him!"

Hei Fu nodded. Ye Zijin's choice was very correct. Fusu had too many people, plus various personal guards, there were more than a hundred people. They were like a bright light in the dark night, attracting all the pursuers!

"So when the Epang prisoners fled in all directions, we broke away from Master Fusu's motorcade in chaos and headed west. Every time we passed a village, we changed carriages. Until we reached Wugong County, Fusu asked Sang Mu to ride A horse took the young gentleman Polu and headed north to join the prince's old army in the north. She herself took the young gentleman Fubo and used a forged talisman to follow me into Hanzhong through Baoxie Road... …”

Heifu served as the Northern Territory Lieutenant for three years. During this period, he promoted a large number of good men and made them the backbone of the Northern Territory Army. He also gave many benefits to the local Rong Dijun chiefs, allowing them to leave the narrow plains and migrate to the rich Helan grassland, which was considered a favor to them.

Polu was born in the Northland, and he was asked to be taken to the Northland by Sangmu. Whether he sought refuge with the local snake Liangjiazi, or managed to get out of the fortress and take him to the Ohara army to hide, he could easily escape.

Hei Fu nodded and sighed: "She is very thoughtful. This trip is dangerous. If something happens, as long as I can escape, I can preserve my bloodline."

After Ye Zijin and Ji Ying entered Hanzhong through the Baoxie Road, as expected, Fusu and his family members attracted all the pursuing forces. In the end, Fusu's wife and children were separated, and he himself was missing.

At this time, Heifu's family cleverly avoided arrest and arrived in Berkshire...

Ba Shi was Heifu's "doorway". He had known Bazhong more than ten years ago, and he generously gave Ba Zhong his brown sugar technology, so that Ba Shi's cinnabar, salt, and iron were all taken over by the Qin Dynasty officials. After being state-owned, relying on the Botong trade and the rising sugar industry, we regained a lot of blood and maintained the commercial building.

From that time on, Ba Shi secretly flirted with Mr. Hei.

The year before last, the imperial court was in financial difficulties and began to kill the goose to lay eggs, and brought the sugar industry into the scope of the franchise. Heifu gave Babi another big gift: brown sugar.

Brown sugar has fewer impurities than lumpy brown sugar and is easier to carry and use.

Relying on brown sugar, Bashi was able to gain some say in the sugar industry.

At this time, Ba Zhong owed Hei Fu two favors and began to feel uneasy, because Hei Fu only helped but never asked for anything.

What Ba Shi respected was Hei Fu's power, but what Hei Fu was greedy for was not Ba Shi's money, but his trade network in Bashu, Dongting and even the Southwest Yi region. In return, with Ba Shi's tacit approval, he could sneak into Xianyang secretly without going through Wuguan with a small number of people.

When Xianyang experienced drastic changes, Ye and his son fled south. It was through Ba's trade network spread across the three counties of Bashu that he safely avoided arrest and went to Ba's base camp, Zhi County, Ba County...

Speaking of this, Ji Ying said with some bitterness: "Bazhong himself did not show up, and his wife received his wife. At first, she looked pleasant and said that she would send her and the gentleman to reunite with the pavilion chief as soon as possible. But after hearing that the First Emperor Nannan After the patrol, he never mentioned anything, only saying that the south was not safe, and that he wanted the lady and the gentleman to rest in Zhi County, and that I had to find the pavilion chief first..."

Ji Ying was so angry that he stamped his feet: "Ba Shi is so ungrateful! Aren't you treating your wife and gentleman as hostages and trying to blackmail the chief of the pavilion?"

"Would Ba Zhong do such a thing?"

Heifu frowned. Based on his past understanding, although Ba Zhong was a merchant, he was very principled and valued kindness and credibility.

Although it was a bit strange and surprising, after thinking about it carefully, Heifu was relieved: "Although Ba Zhong talks about credibility, Ba Zhong is a merchant after all. Everything is based on profit and is sold at a price. This is what merchants are best at." What’s more, this is a major matter involving genocide.”

Heifu shook his head and said: "Everyone is afraid of Qin Shihuang, even in barbarian and despicable areas. If I die and become a traitor, Ba Shi can offer my wife and renounce his relationship with me. On the contrary, Then it can be delivered immediately.”

Therefore, the safety of his family depends entirely on his future success or failure!

At this time, Ji Ying looked at the simple camp, and his heart pounded: "Ting Pavilion Chief, what should we do now?"

This is not only Ji Ying's question, but also the question of those old men who followed Hei Fu here after Beijiang Dao's death.

"Your Majesty, what should we do!?"

Surrounding Heifu were a total of 3,000 short-soldiers who had identified themselves. Heifu deceived Ziying. This group of people was not dispersed and stationed in various places. Instead, they acted as attackers to Heifu south of Hengpu Pass. "More people".

That night, they followed Heifu and entered Changsha County through Yangshan Pass. They arrived at Changsha Camp and met up with Xiaotao. After leaving a thousand people behind, the remaining three thousand were divided into small groups and divided into small groups. They stayed in the camp during the day and went out at night. It opened to cities such as Linxiang and was hidden in the Yunmeng Daze in the south of the Yangtze River.

It is now mid-February, and the group has been hiding for half a month.

After running out of dry food, they could only eat fruits, cockroaches and clams to satisfy their hunger. They had no complaints, but even the most loyal warriors to Heifu would inevitably feel frightened when faced with this unknown future.

Without exception, this group of people were all descendants of Nanjun, including eight hundred Anlu people. They were all very anxious when they heard that their families would be moved as hostages.

"Rebellion! The pavilion chief should take us back to Anlu!"

Dongmen Bao's family is not in Anlu, but in Yuzhang, so he has no scruples. The reckless man who can't stand this kind of bird-like attitude has been encouraging Heifu to rebel in the middle of the river!

However, Heifu never expressed his position. He only looked up at the sun that was slowly setting in the sky, and thought to himself: "As long as Qin Shihuang is still here, I won't be able to do anything..."

"And because of the big plaque of 'Wuzhonghou', even if I do something, it can't be against Qin. Otherwise, even among the Southern Expeditionary Army, public opinion will be very detrimental to me!"

Fortunately, at this moment, a small boat sailed around the complex reed swamp and docked nearby, but Li Cang, who had been monitoring near Anlu, came back.

Li Cang came over and bowed down: "Your Majesty, Captain Feng Jing is searching for villages and destroying cities in Anlu. He wants to gather all the Anlu people near the county seat. On the first day of March, he will drive them north to enter the pass!"

"Um."

Heifu chewed a piece of grass in his mouth, digesting this very unfavorable news and thinking about how to deal with it.

"Your Majesty, there is one more thing."

After talking about the situation in Anlu, Li Cang reported to Heifu the whereabouts of Qin Shi Huang's chariot.

"The First Emperor's majestic cavalry stopped at Xiling for a few days, then arrived at Zhu City, and then turned north and headed for the Three Fortresses of Ming'e!"

Just now I heard that Anlu was going to relocate the entire county on the first day of March. Hei Fu just sat cross-legged, holding his chin in his hands and thinking, but now he stood up suddenly and spat out the grass in his mouth.

"Are you sure you are going north instead of east to Kuaiji!?"

After Xiang Licang repeatedly confirmed that the matter was true, Heifu looked up to the sky and smiled, but the laughter became lower and lower, and finally turned into uncontrollable crying.

Everyone watched in surprise as Hei Fu bowed towards the north again, Chang Zuo bowed and said:

"His Majesty the First Emperor has passed away!"

"The days are longing, and the world has been waiting so hard for this scorching sun to finally set."

Heifu raised his head, unable to control his emotions, and burst into tears:

"But why am I happy and sad at the same time?"

…
